summary: Identity press against freedom and disruption. This frictional pattern asks you to use confidence and originality with awareness.
body: Identity press against freedom and disruption. This frictional pattern asks you to use confidence and originality with awareness. Difference for its own sake: eccentricity, instability, shocking people to no purpose. The friction makes the pattern noticeable, especially when pressure forces an adjustment. In practice, this can show up through identity, freedom and disruption, and the choices you make when ego defense or instability starts running the room.
gift: The gift is confidence, originality, and a more conscious way to work with identity and freedom and disruption.
shadow: The shadow is ego defense, instability, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let identity and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
do: Name how identity and freedom and disruption are both involved
Pause before choosing the most familiar reaction
Turn confidence and originality into one concrete choice
dont: Let ego defense make the decision
Treat tension as proof that something is wrong
Ignore the needs of identity or freedom and disruption
